files_modified.description: Fixed mark_completed call keyword argument, handled tool failure telemetry recording, removed duplicate finish_request, and hardened Tier 3 failure and cost attribution.
Hardened parser strategies (1-7) to reject empty parameters for write/read/bash tools and reject demo placeholders like 'full content here'.
Added TargetFile/CodeContent aliases to PARAM_ALIASES and preserved leading/trailing whitespace for content parameter.
Removed destructive \n and \" string replacements, added newline='' for exact byte fidelity on Windows, and preserved code indentation.
Refined atomic prompt detection in _parse_intent, eliminated forced Minimum 8 tasks explosion, properly handled project root for single file extensions, and scoped workspace inspection.
Scoped StructuredFeedbackGenerator verification strictly to files modified in the current task iteration, eliminating cross-task contamination.
Wired MissionPlanner and MissionRunner into execute_task, dynamically aligning workspace_target with task workspace and aggregating multi-step telemetry.
